subject: general
question: What was the role of the National Dairy Development Board (NDDin the Technology Mission on Oilseeds?

options.text: To manage oilseed procurement and processing

solution:
The correct answer is __**To manage oilseed procurement and processing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Dairy Development Board (NDDB) played a significant role in the **Technology Mission on Oilseeds (TMO)**, which was launched by the Indian government in 1986.
 
• NDDB was involved in **managing oilseed procurement, processing, and marketing** to ensure fair prices for farmers and improve the domestic production of edible oils.
 
• It facilitated the establishment of several oilseed cooperatives, modeled after the Anand Pattern, to empower farmers and streamline the supply chain.
 
• The NDDB also helped in **reducing India's dependency on imported edible oils** by promoting self-sufficiency through technological and infrastructural support.
 
• This initiative was part of the broader mission to **increase oilseed production** and reduce the gap between demand and supply in the edible oil sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Technology Mission on Oilseeds (TMO):**

 
 
• Launched in 1986 under the leadership of then-Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi to make India self-reliant in edible oil production.
 
• It aimed at improving productivity and minimizing post-harvest losses through better technology and infrastructure.
 
• The mission focused on key oilseeds such as groundnut, soybean, sunflower, rapeseed, and mustard.
 
 
 
• **Role of NDDB in Agriculture:**
 
 
• Established in 1965, NDDB is known for its pivotal contribution to the White Revolution in India.
 
• It extended its expertise to other agricultural sectors, including oilseeds, to replicate the success of Operation Flood.
 
• NDDB works towards strengthening rural economies by forming cooperatives and ensuring better returns for farmers.
 
 
 
• **Edible Oil Scenario in India:**
 
 
• India is one of the largest consumers and importers of edible oils in the world.
 
• The high dependency on imports has been a concern, necessitating missions like TMO to boost domestic production.
 
• Key imported edible oils include palm oil, soybean oil, and sunflower oil.
 
 
 
• **Current Initiatives in Edible Oil Sector:**
 
 
• The government has launched the National Mission on Edible Oils-Oil Palm (NMEO-OP) to promote oil palm cultivation.
 
• This mission aims to reduce import dependency and ensure better returns for farmers.
 
• It focuses on the northeastern states and Andaman & Nicobar Islands for oil palm cultivation.
